selection.algorithm: SHA-256 rank of archive member path or directory-relative path after prior-file exclusion

labels.perspective: player to move, called nextPlayer in KataGo writer
labels.policy_counts: MCTS visit target0, current position; zeros do not mean illegal
labels.value_probs: final/TD target globalTargetsNC[0:3] (win, loss, no-result); weight=(1-[35]) if [62]=1 else 0
labels.score_mean: final/TD scalar score globalTargetsNC[3]; weight=[27] if [62]=1 else 0
labels.score_distr: final score distribution scoreDistrN/100 at use time; weight=[27] if [62]=1 else 0; unavailable rows contain dummy bins
labels.ownership: final ownership valueTargetsNCHW[0], +1 for player to move; weight=[27] if [62]=1 else 0

note: Original archive and shard cache are Git-ignored; deterministic preparation can recreate them after copying the source archive.

benchmark_input_pack.selection: first 32 full-board rows from source NPZ, which belongs to excluded prior sample
